data: Does the LaserTaggerFF have the best performance for sentence fusion at 450 training examples?

The question asks whether the LaserTaggerFF has the best performance for sentence fusion at 450 training examples. From the caption, it is stated that unless there are tens of thousands of training examples, the tagging approach clearly outperforms the seq2seq baseline. The figure shows the SARI score as a function of the training data size for three models. At 450 training examples, the LaserTaggerFF line is below the LaserTaggerAR line, indicating that the LaserTaggerAR performs better than the LaserTaggerFF at this point. Therefore, the answer is no, the LaserTaggerFF does not have the best performance for sentence fusion at 450 training examples.
